description: This file defines a React component for managing and displaying linked items within a UI, including handling focus, linking, un-linking, and collapsing/expanding the view.

methods.name: focusPreviousItem
methods.description: Sets focus to the previous linked item in the list, if any.

methods.name: focusNextItem
methods.description: Sets focus to the next linked item in the list, if any.

methods.name: activateItemAndTogglePane
methods.description: Activates a linked item and toggles the app pane corresponding to the item.

methods.name: isItemBidirectionallyLinked
methods.description: Determines if a link is bidirectionally connected to the current item.
